title: Evaluation of an Out-of-Hospital Palliative Care Center: A Retrospective Analysis of Secondary Data
summary: Purpose of the study is to analyze anonymized routine data from the Infinitas Palliative Care Center. The results are intended to provide insights into care and identify potential areas for improvement.
conditions: Palliative care patients admitted to the infinitas Palliative Care Center due to oncological and non-oncological conditions

interventions.name: Retrospective data analysis of all adult patients admitted to the palliative care center between April 2024 and March 2026, inclusive, who subsequently died. The retrospective data will be entered and analyzed using SPSS.

criteria:
